content.text: Measured two candidates so far. Index 15 (InSbO₄ region) gave a small signal and index 6 gave none. Next I'm running XRD to find which phases are actually present.
All EQE measurements are used up. Index 19 is the best so far, so I'm submitting it.

input.rationale: XRD shows a single rutile-type (In,Sb)O2/InSbO4 phase from Sb≈0.5 to 0.72 (peaks at Q 1.87/2.37/2.65/3.55). At Sb=0.22 bixbyite In2O3 also appears, and the In11Sb3O24 phase predicted there did not form. The 2.4 eV photons are near or below the band gap, so all EQE values are tiny. EQE measured across the rutile region peaked at Sb=0.653 (0.0116%), compared with 0.0069% at 0.51 and 0.0063% at 0.75.

content.text:
I submitted **index 19 (Sb fraction 0.653)**. It had the highest EQE I measured, at 0.0116%. All the signals are very small, probably because the 2.4 eV light is close to or below the band gap of the material that actually formed.

All 5 EQE measurements are used. I used 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) | Phase from XRD |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.22 | −0.00001 | In₂O₃ mixed with a rutile-type phase |
| 11 | 0.37 | −0.020 | not measured |
| 15 | 0.51 | 0.0069 | rutile-type only |
| **19** | **0.65** | **0.0116** | not measured |
| 22 | 0.75 | 0.0063 | not measured (index 21, at 0.72, was rutile-type only) |

- **What formed:** From about Sb 0.5 to 0.72 the film is a single rutile-type In–Sb oxide. At Sb 0.22 there is also In₂O₃. The In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄ phase expected near 0.21 did not form. It had the smallest predicted band gap (1.9 eV) and was my first target, but it gave no signal.
- **Where the peak is:** EQE rises from the In-rich side to a maximum near 0.65, then drops again at 0.75.
- **Limits:** Index 19 is the best of five points, not a located optimum. The unmeasured neighbours (indices 18 and 20, Sb 0.62 and 0.69) could be slightly better. The phase-matching tool also scored the database phases poorly against the measured patterns. I identified the rutile-type phase from its peak positions, not from a confirmed match.
